scenarios.name: airline-it-outage
scenarios.title: Airline IT outage at ATL
scenarios.description: Company-request ground stop at ATL during an airline IT outage; weather is fine.

assert.note: needs FAA cause classification (cause.mjs, other branch)

scenarios.name: all-clear
scenarios.title: All clear
scenarios.description: Quiet weather everywhere, no FAA programs, every source up. Includes the global shards: EGLL (international, METAR + TAF), KFCM (small US, METAR only) and Y49 (no reports).

scenarios.name: atc-staffing-ground-stop
scenarios.title: ATC staffing ground stop at EWR
scenarios.description: Clear weather everywhere; the FAA stops traffic to EWR for air traffic control staffing.

assert.note: needs FAA cause classification (cause.mjs, other branch)

scenarios.name: full-closure
scenarios.title: MCO closed for a hurricane
scenarios.description: Full airport closure NOTAM at MCO with a Hurricane Warning and hurricane-force gusts.

scenarios.name: lax-ga-only-closure

scenarios.name: source-outage
scenarios.title: FAA status feed down
scenarios.description: The FAA NAS status request fails; everything else works. The page must say FAA status is unavailable.

scenarios.name: stale-data
scenarios.title: Stale data (poller stopped 50 min ago)
scenarios.description: The last successful poll was 50 minutes ago. The page must flag it as stale.

scenarios.name: thunderstorm-ground-stop
scenarios.title: Thunderstorm ground stop at ORD
scenarios.description: Severe thunderstorms over Chicago: FAA ground stop at ORD, convective SIGMET, Severe Thunderstorm Warning, SPC Enhanced risk.

assert.note: needs FAA cause classification (cause.mjs, other branch)

scenarios.name: winter-storm-gdp
